stories.title: Iowa turns tables on Michigan with TD on final play
stories.summary: Iowa stunned Michigan with a last-second, 16-yard touchdown pass to lift the No. 17 Hawkeyes over the No. 18 Wolverines 20-19.

stories.title: Surging No. 21 Florida hammers No. 4 Ole Miss as favorite
stories.summary: Jadan Baugh ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns, and No. 21 Florida manhandled fourth-ranked Ole Miss 52-28 on Saturday to reach 4-0 for the first time since 2019.

stories.title: Horns' Simmons apologizes for miming urinating on field vs. Vols
stories.summary: Texas star defensive end Colin Simmons apologized for drawing an unsportsmanlike conduct penalty for 'simulating using the restroom' in the first half of Saturday's win at Tennessee.

stories.title: Emotional Verlander leaves final start after daughter's surprise mound visit
stories.summary: Justin Verlander got an unexpected hook in his major league finale, when the 7-year-old daughter of the pitcher and model Kate Upton came to the mound.

stories.title: Sources: Bulls trading Dillingham to Hornets for Hield
stories.summary: The Chicago Bulls are trading Rob Dillingham to the Charlotte Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Saturday.
